All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
BackgroundLayer
Represents a single parallax background layer.
Bullet
Represents a projectile fired by the player.
CameraSystem
Camera system that tracks the player's horizontal position.
Character
Abstract base class representing a controllable character entity.
CloudEffect
Visual-only particle effect used when performing a double-jump.
Coin
Represents a collectible coin.
CombatSystem
Handles combat-related interactions within a game scene.
DifficultyConfig
Holds gameplay parameters based on selected difficulty.
DifficultyFactory
Factory for creating DifficultyConfig instances.
DifficultyLevel
Defines the available difficulty levels.
Enemy
Represents an enemy character.
EnemyBehaviorSystem
Controls enemy movement and behaviour during gameplay.
Entity
Abstract base class for all game entities.
GameApp
Entry point of the CyborgPlatform JavaFX game application.
GameEngine
Core game engine responsible for coordinating all gameplay systems.
GameObject
Abstract base class for all interactive game objects.
InputManager
Centralised handler for keyboard input state.
LevelBuilder
Factory class for constructing fully initialised game scenes.
MusicPlayer
Singleton controller responsible for background music playback.
PhysicsSystem
Physics simulation system responsible for applying movement and resolving collisions within the game world.
Platform
Represents a static solid surface in the game world.
Player
Represents the player character.
PlayerControlSystem
Interprets player input and updates the player's intended actions.
Preferences
Stores player-selected preferences.
PreferencesManager
Central access point for runtime player preferences.
Renderer
Responsible for rendering all visual elements of the game.
ResourceManager
ResourceManager is the central system for loading and caching runtime assets.
Scene
Represents a game scene that owns and manages all active game objects.
SceneManager
Manages transitions between game scenes and tracks the active scene.
ScoreManager
Manages the player's score during a gameplay session.
StartScreenScene
Start screen scene used to configure player preferences before starting the main game.
TileBlock
Represents a single tile-based platform created from a map definition.
TileManager
Loads tile-based level geometry from a map file.
TileType
Defines all tile categories used for constructing static level geometry.
